picks.name: 3001 Overshirt, army green
picks.why: There's still no overshirt in the wardrobe, and it's the missing layer for the everyday and travel outfits. A heavy cotton chore-coat cut with a regular body, patch pockets and only a small woven label, now 30% off and under target. Wear it open over a charcoal tee with the 502s and Sambas.

picks.name: Lambswool Saddle Shoulder Crew Neck, navy
picks.why: The office outfit still has no knit, and this is the 'fewer, better' version: fully fashioned 100% lambswool knitted in Hawick, with a saddle shoulder that sits neatly rather than dropping, full-length sleeves and no branding. Wear it over a tee with the fawn chinos and brown Docs for work, or with dark denim on a weekend.

picks.name: T-Shirt, charcoal
picks.why: Tees remain the biggest gap: none owned against a target of four, and nearly every outfit starts with one. A regular-fit, 200g organic cotton crew made in the UK, heavy enough to sit flat under a knit or the overshirt, with no logo. Charcoal works under navy, olive and stone alike.
